Kingdom

What should power make room for?

Kingdom brings together questions of agency, restraint, faith and care. The recurring question is how power can help others flourish while leaving them room to act.

Begin with kenosis, then follow its difficult boundary: when does restraint protect freedom, and when does care require intervention?
